final_rationale: The verdict does not change because no genuinely new admissible evidence was provided. The Actor materially narrowed the claim and correctly conceded that the record does not support a clean no-disclosure determination, but that is an explanation about the same evidence, not evidence itself. The key unresolved compliance predicate remains: admissible evidence shows a material weakness affecting a named launch use case, while policy requires such a limitation to be disclosed or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. There is still no admissible proof of either condition. That distinction matters for proportionality: a caveated framing may better describe the business posture, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats when the caveat is itself an unsatisfied policy requirement rather than a peripheral qualification. On this record, certification now is not evidentially supported.
remaining_concerns: The multilingual customer-support segment still misses target and is a named launch use case in two regional support commitments, which keeps the weakness material under the stated policy.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed remains open.
No admissible evidence shows a final disclosure artifact or approved risk acceptance covering this material limitation before launch.
Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness but do not satisfy the separate policy predicate for a material limitation.
The Actor's narrowed framing is a reinterpretation of the same record, not new admissible evidence curing the missing compliance requirement.
